سِخْنَةٌ : see the next preceding paragraph. ―
-b2- One says also, عَلَيْكَ بِالأَمْرِ عِنْدَ سِخْنَتِهِ, meaning (assumed tropical:) [Keep thou to the affair] while it is in its first state, before it become cold [i. e. unmanageable, like cold iron]. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
